nextcloudSection.panelDescription: Uploads recognized pieces (image + part number + color) to your own Nextcloud, sorted so the data can train a custom model later.

uploadingActive.label: Uploading active
uploadingActive.help: Send recognized pieces to Nextcloud as they come in.

targetFolder.label: Target folder
targetFolder.help: Path in the Nextcloud where the data is stored.

minConfidence.label: Minimum confidence
minConfidence.help: Pieces below this score count as not confidently identified and go in the _unidentified folder. Leave blank for no threshold.

uploadUnidentified.label: Upload unidentified pieces
uploadUnidentified.help: Also upload pieces with no confident match, into their own _unidentified folder - often the most valuable future training data.

pictureSettingsSidebar.noCamera: Choose a camera to see these changes live.

status.resetUsbAndTransforms: Reset USB camera controls and feed transforms to sane defaults. Save to apply.
status.resetTransforms: Reset feed transforms to defaults. Save to apply.

captureTrainingFrames.label: Capture training frames
captureTrainingFrames.info: Takes the latest frame from every live camera at the rate below, only while the machine is sorting. Frames are saved to a capped store on this machine and uploaded to Hive in the background. It never changes how the machine sorts.

annotateOpenRouter.label: Annotate with OpenRouter
annotateOpenRouter.info: Runs the Gemini (gemini_sam) detector on each frame before it is saved, so samples reach Hive as teacher captures. It makes one OpenRouter call per frame per camera. Off, or with no API key, frames are saved and uploaded raw.

decayCaptureRate.label: Decay capture rate
decayCaptureRate.info: Takes a burst of frames when a run starts, then slows down to a floor over the ramp, with random jitter, so the same rig stops saving near-identical frames forever. Reset decay starts the burst again.

captureRate.label: Capture rate
captureRate.info: Frames per minute per camera: at most 0.5, one every 2 minutes.

sampleStoreSize.label: Sample store size
sampleStoreSize.info: Keep at most this much on this machine, never more than Hive allows. When it is full, samples every Hive already has are deleted first, then the oldest.
sampleStoreSize.defaultHelp: Follow the size Hive sets again.

sampleCaptureSection.notInitialized: The sample collector hasn't started on this machine (no camera service yet).
sampleCaptureSection.droppedQueueFull: {count} frames dropped since startup because saving could not keep up.
sampleCaptureSection.skippedLowDisk: {count} frames skipped since startup because the disk was low on space.

decayDetails.graphAriaLabel: The capture rate falling from the burst rate to the floor over the ramp

burstInterval.label: Burst interval
burstInterval.info: Seconds between frames per camera right after a reset. Never faster than Hive allows, nor than one every 2 minutes.
burstInterval.defaultHelp: Follow the interval Hive sets again.

floorInterval.label: Floor interval
floorInterval.info: Minutes between frames per camera once the decay has settled.
floorInterval.defaultHelp: Follow the interval Hive sets again.

ramp.label: Ramp
ramp.info: Hours to go from the burst interval to the floor interval.
ramp.defaultHelp: Follow the ramp Hive sets again.

jitter.label: Jitter
jitter.info: Random wobble on each interval so captures aren't perfectly periodic.

errors.loadFailed: Failed to reach the servo settings.

servoBackendSection.panelDescription: Where layer-gate servo commands go: a control board's PCA9685 channels, or the ESP32 BLE gate bridge.

backendField.label: Backend
backendField.help: Changing this needs the hardware re-homed afterward.

bleDeviceField.label: BLE device
bleDeviceField.help: The BLE address of the esp32_ble_servo_bridge board, e.g. AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF.

demoModeField.label: Demo mode
demoModeField.help: The bridge board answers every gate command as if a real servo moved, after the same delay a real move takes — without driving the servo bus. Applies immediately, persists across reboots.
